messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kal raat se sir dard hai aur subah se halka bukhaar bhi hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ye viral lagta hai. Do din aaram karo, paani zyada piyo, bukhaar badhne par doctor ko dikhao.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sorry, pichhle hafte wali baat ka reply ab de rahi hoon, teen din tak tabiyat bahut kharab thi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Koi baat nahi. Ab bukhaar kaisa hai, utar gaya ya abhi bhi 100 se upar hai?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Abhi subah 99.2 tha, shaam ko thoda badh jata hai. Khaansi bhi parso se shuru hui hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Khaansi agar ek hafte se zyada rahe to chest X-ray karwao. Tuesday ko clinic khuli hai, waha dikha do.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, Tuesday ko appointment le lungi. Waise neend pichhle kuch din se poori nahi ho rahi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Neend ki kami se recovery slow hoti hai. Sone se pehle phone band rakho aur kamre ki light dim karo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tuesday ki appointment ho gayi, doctor ne kaha viral bronchitis hai aur antibiotics diye.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Achha. Antibiotics poora course tak lena, beech mein band mat karna. Teen din baad bukhaar check karo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Teen din baad bukhaar utar gaya aur khaansi kam hui. Parso se chest mein halka dard hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Chest dard agar saans lene mein ho to turant wapas jao. Warna agle mahine follow-up rakh lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Saans theek hai. Agle mahine ki follow-up visit book kar li hai, pandrah tareekh ko.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Bahut achha. Tab tak paani aur neend ka dhyan rakho, aur report mujhe bhej dena.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Agle mahine ki shaadi ki taiyari shuru karni hai, lekin venue final nahi hua.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pehle guest list banao, phir venue dekhenge. Pichhle saal wala garden wapas try karo?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Wo garden pichhle saal mehnga tha. Parso main do naye venue dekhne ja rahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Achha, dekh ke photos bhej dena. Budget kitna fix kiya hai?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sorry, parso busy ho gayi thi, ek venue pasand aaya lekin deposit zyada maang rahe hain.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Deposit usually negotiable hota hai. Unse baat karo aur likhit quote lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Teen din baad unka manager milne aa raha hai, tab baat karungi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi. Caterer ko bhi Tuesday tak confirm kar do, log jaldi book ho jate hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Caterer wale ne kaha is hafte tak booking kar do warna rate badh jayega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: To aaj hi advance de do. Photographer ka kya scene hai?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Photographer mil gaya, wahi jo pehle suggest kiya tha.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Perfect. Venue ka advance agle hafte tak ho jayega?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan, parso manager se milne ke baad final karungi. Sab kuch tight schedule mein hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Tension mat lo, sab ho jayega. Roz thoda progress note karo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Is baar ke exam ki tayari shuru ki hai, lekin syllabus bahut lamba hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Roz do ghante padho, subah wala time best hai. Pichhle attempt ka pattern dekh lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Pichhle attempt mein time kam pad gaya tha, is baar strategy change kar rahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Mock test hafte mein do baar do, warna speed nahi banegi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sorry do hafte se message nahi kiya, ghar mein function tha isliye padhai ruki.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Koi baat nahi. Ab wapas track par aa jao, abhi bhi kaafi time bacha hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Parso se daily mock dena shuru kiya, score pehle se better hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Achha. Weak topics list banao aur unhe subah slot mein rakho.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Maths weak hai. Tuesday ko teacher se doubt clear karne ja rahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi hai. Tuesday ke baad ek full mock do aur mujhe score batao.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Teen din baad full mock diya, 62 percent aaya. Pehle 48 tha.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Badhiya improvement. Agle mahine exam hai, ab revision par focus karo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Agle mahine ke first week mein exam hai, uske baad result ka wait.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: All the best. Exam se ek din pehle naya topic mat chhedna.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Agle mahine flat shift karna hai, lekin naya ghar abhi tak nahi mila.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pehle purane ghar ka notice period dekh lo, warna deposit kat jayega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Pichhle hafte landlord se baat ki, unhone ek mahine ka notice maanga hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Theek hai, to aaj se count karo. Broker ko bhi bolo ki jaldi options bheje.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sorry parso se busy thi, do din se broker ka reply nahi aaya.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Khud bhi online dekho, sirf broker par depend mat raho.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kal do flat dekhne gayi thi, ek bahut pasand aaya lekin rent zyada tha.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Rent thoda negotiate karo, ya parking charge hatane ko bolo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aaj landlord ko call kiya, unhone parking free karne ko kaha.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Badhiya. Agreement Tuesday ko sign karna, usse pehle sab check kar lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tuesday ko agreement sign ho gaya, deposit bhi de di.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ab purane ghar ka final bill clear karo aur packing agle hafte shuru karo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Packing agle hafte se shuru karungi, movers ko bhi book kiya hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi. Shift wale din purana ghar khali kar dena, warna extra charge lagega.
